guidelines.detail: refines SUB-05 (The description connects every return with another delivery, and the missing flows show that this repeated path was not preserved. SUB-05 addresses explicit repetition; this guideline clarifies that the follow-up must occur for each occurrence.)

same as LRN-002 (The label pairs show substitutions or additions in labels, while the description provides the actions and outcomes to preserve. This is already covered essentially by learned guideline LRN-002; FID-03 also advises short, faithful labels.)

same as LRN-008 (The description says item selection and payment-method selection happen simultaneously, while the records show the parallel gateways and their connecting flows are absent from the generated model. The proposed guideline is essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-008.)

documentation rule FID-03 not applied (The records include labels that reflect described actions, but “Items kept” asserts an outcome not stated in the description. The proposed wording is already covered by FID-03, which requires short, faithful labels.)

same as LRN-008 (The description supports concurrent branches for the actions it says occur simultaneously or independently, and the missing flows show that this structure was not represented. LRN-008 already states the same core modeling guidance.)

documentation rule FID-03 not applied (The generated labels “Items kept” and “Receive initial delivery” do not faithfully preserve the stated outcome or action; the description says the items are delivered. FID-03 already calls for short, faithful labels.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an action may recur and that each occurrence causes a follow-up action to happen again.: Model the recurring action and its follow-up as a loop or cycle so that every occurrence leads to the stated follow-up.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an action may recur and that each occurrence causes a follow-up action to happen again.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies actions or outcomes at distinct stages of a process: Label each BPMN element to reflect the action or outcome described at that stage; do not substitute a different action, a later-stage action, or an unsupported outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or outcome at a process stage, especially when a related action or a different participant perspective could be confused with it

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies multiple independent activities that must all be completed before a later activity can begin: model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them with a parallel join before the later activity
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly requires concurrent work, or states that one task does not depend on another task

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or outcome at a particular stage
